プロトタイプについて: 能力値・類似選手・推奨戦術・コンディション・直近の調子な: About this prototype: ability ratings, similar players, recommended tactics, condition and recent form are estimates computed by AI, not official data. The 'current contract' field is based on reported transfer fees and contract types (permanent transfer / free / loan / homegrown and so on) and contains no non-public information such as wages or salaries. For some players, contract-fee data has not yet been researched and is shown as 'unregistered'. Players' basic profiles are based on information that could be confirmed as of 7/2026, and may not reflect the latest developments such as transfers. When you open a player card, real data is automatically fetched from 3 free external APIs - OpenLigaDB (Bayern's actual Bundesliga results), TheSportsDB (real player photos and basic information) and Wikipedia (actual descriptive text) - and shown alongside the AI-estimated data (if any of them fails, a notice is shown automatically and the tool does not break). If you start the proxy server in the bundled server/ folder and set an API-Football (paid) key, players' current-season records (appearances, goals, assists, average rating) and today's actual fixture list also switch automatically to real data (if not configured, only the AI simulation is shown, as before). Connected to real stats APIs (Opta/StatsBomb and the like), video tracking or a large language model, it could also support far more advanced real-time analysis.
